description: Manual-trigger-only collector of visible Facebook Page followers for giveaway roulette: persistent-profile Puppeteer service, URL dedupe, Data Table storage, results visible via the Control Panel GUI.
name: Facebook Giveaway Followers Collector

parameters.content: ## Architecture (why no browser in Compose n8n image). The official n8n image has no Chromium and Code nodes have no network access, so Puppeteer cannot run inside n8n; the VPS browser-collector service (scripts/fb-followers-collector, persistent profile, loopback-guarded API, noVNC) is the authorized exception. n8n drives it over HTTP only (http://browser:5679 on the Compose network). Never expose the collector publicly. Auth handoff: open noVNC, log into Facebook manually in the VPS Chromium window (2FA/captcha/checkpoint all manual), rerun workflow. On expiry the run stops at AUTH_REQUIRED — repeat login, rerun. No Facebook credentials ever enter n8n. Every run stores its full result (raw + roulette rows, stats) in the giveaway_runs Data Table, keyed by runId — visible and downloadable from the Control Panel GUI. No separate dry-run/commit distinction, no external Sheets or Telegram integration. GUI Input trigger accepts panel calls (manual-trigger-only preserved: no schedule; every run is human-initiated).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "followersUrl": $('Giveaway Config').item.json.followersUrl, "scrollDelayMs": $('Giveaway Config').item.json.scrollDelayMs, "postScrollWaitMs": $('Giveaway Config').item.json.postScrollWaitMs, "emptyScrollThreshold": $('Giveaway Config').item.json.emptyScrollThreshold, "maxScrollAttempts": $('Giveaway Config').item.json.maxScrollAttempts, "runLabel": $('Giveaway Config').item.json.runLabel, "runId": $('Giveaway Config').item.json.runId } }}

parameters.content: ## Per-giveaway config lives in Giveaway Config (Code node, top of flow). Edit followersUrl, collector URL, runLabel, timing (scrollDelayMs/postScrollWaitMs), thresholds (emptyScrollThreshold default 10, maxScrollAttempts cap) there. Dedupe is by normalized profile URL/identifier — never by display name. Every run's full result (raw + roulette rows, stats) is stored in the giveaway_runs Data Table, keyed by runId; view or download it from the Control Panel GUI. No external Sheets or Telegram integration.

versionMetadata.description: User decided to drop Telegram entirely rather than configure a real chat ID: telegramChatId was still the placeholder PASTE_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, causing the two Send Telegram nodes to hard-fail every run that reached AUTH_REQUIRED or the failure branch (visible as n8n node-issue errors). Results are now surfaced entirely through the Control Panel GUI (live log + Download/View JSON), so there's no remaining use for the Telegram path. Removes the 3 Build*Report/Message Code nodes and 3 Send Telegram nodes; both branches (auth-required, invalid-data) now simply end without a further action. Leaves the now-empty telegramChatId Data Table column in place, unused, consistent with how the earlier Sheets-column removal was handled.
versionMetadata.name: Remove Telegram reporting
